title: Piloting UAP/orbs by moving consciousness into them in the lab

tellings.quote: So, for example, let's say there was an orb or something and I was asked to fly it.

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at a place called Baker Victory Services in New York, a boy was asked in a lab to fly glowing orbs, or UAP (the government's term for unidentified flying objects), by moving his consciousness into them. Jordan Jose, who says a secret UFO programme took him as a child, tells it as something he did himself. If true, it would mean such craft can be steered by the mind.
